items.arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
items.translation: And when My servants ask you concerning Me — indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.
Whoever fasts Ramadan out of faith and seeking reward, his previous sins will be forgiven.
